item.description:
Personal life

I happen to be married to an incredible mathematician Alisa Chistopolskaya.

Our two cats Sheavetz (small sheaf) and Pafnuty Lvovich Chebyshev.

Since now it is prohibited in Russia to spread LGBTQIA+ “propaganda,” here is an official admission: I am an asexual. Fuck Vladimir Putin, Roskomnadzor, the Russian parliament, and all other Russian “authorities” responsible for this “law” and everything else that happened before, after, and during 2022.
